Totally reasonable — thanks for flagging. Two pragmatic options we can offer today (no legal heavy lifting needed for the first):

Option A — Fast option (operational): 2-week no-cost extension to the evaluation window + a $8,000 account credit applied to the first invoice if you convert to a paid pilot within 30 days of the amended end date. We can implement this from our side immediately and update your HubSpot record.

Option B — Commercial incentive (requires a simple amendment): 3-week extension + a 7% volume discount on the first three months of committed usage if you sign an LOI by July 1. Our legal team can push a 1-paragraph amendment to DocuSign (low friction).

If you want to go faster, pick Option A and I'll apply the extension today. If you prefer Option B, I can prepare the amendment draft and loop Rishi/Grace for sign-off.
